svg.title: The failed review check on a pull request on another base
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0045. With reviewer hints on, the executor completes the check run shadewright/review on the recorded head commit as failed and records it Stale in five cases: a stale plan, a cancel or a stop reads the request's own pull request open on a base other than the target branch; a stale plan or a cancel reads it closed there, because a closed pull request can be reopened; and a stopped holder whose own pull request is not open looks while another open pull request from its branch holds the lock and no failed check is last on the recorded head, whatever its own pull request is, because the check belongs to the request's own commit; and a stale plan, a cancel or a stop reads it gone, because the check is on the request's own commit and can only keep that commit from merging. Whenever the pull request is not read open on the target branch the summary is a fixed variant that promises no close, with one constant or none, never text from the code host. A pull request merged on another base, or read gone after a new installation of the repository, gets no check, and nothing is written when hints are off or when the read fails. When writes are paused, the settings entry names another target branch, the repository is gone or the Git host fails the write, the condition ReviewCheckNotFailed says so and the next look tries again. Never on another base: push, comment, merge, update of title or body. No new read and no new grant.
svg.text: A REQUEST STOPS
Stale plan, cancel or stop
Own pull request read open or closed on
another base: stale plan, cancel, stop
(a closed one can reopen). Or a stopped
holder's own one is not open while another
from its branch holds the lock (any state).
Read gone counts too. Only with hints on.
WRITTEN
Failed check shadewright/review
On the recorded head commit, recorded
Stale: never written again, any state.
Summary: fixed variant, promises no close;
one constant at most, never host text.
These are the only writes there besides
the close.
EFFECT
A pass from before no longer
stands as the last check
A check run belongs to the commit, so
it shows on any base. Moved back, or
merged where the ruleset requires it
from the App, the pull request is
blocked. Where it does not, nothing is.
NOT WRITTEN
Hints off. Merged on the other base (nothing left
to block). After a reinstall of the repository. Read
failed: nothing is written, the read is retried.
WRITTEN LATER, SAID IN STATUS
Writes paused, entry names another target branch,
repository gone, or the Git host fails the write:
condition ReviewCheckNotFailed, tried again at the next look.
Never on another base
no push, comment, merge or update of title or body; the close stays the finalizer's (ADR-0043).
No new read and no new grant: the App's checks: write already covers the check run.
